C0833.title: University of Shanghai for Science and Technology Launches Weak Password Self-Inspection Campaign
keywords: University of Shanghai for Science and Technology
C0833.summary: In June 2026, the Information Office of the University of Shanghai for Science and Technology issued a notice requiring a university-wide inspection of websites, application systems, business platforms, and personal accounts for weak passwords. It prohibited typical weak passwords such as admin, password, and 123456, and required stronger password complexity, regular changes, login-failure lockout, and multi-factor authentication management. The notice required immediate remediation or remediation plans and submission of a rectification list by June 16.

references.title: Notice on Conducting a Special Self-Inspection and Rectification of 'Weak Passwords'
